# API contract changelog

<!-- Generated by `make sdk-gen-typescript` from sdk/changelog. DO NOT EDIT. -->

This is the shared API contract history for TypeScript SDK users, not the package release history. Package versions are independent of the contract versions below. Unreleased changes describe the current contract, not a published SDK. Calls and streams use SDK method names: `create_order` is `client.createOrder(...)`, `trade_stream` is `client.tradeStream(...)` in this SDK.

Contract versions follow semver. Before 1.0.0 the minor digit is the breaking one: a breaking change goes from 0.3.x to 0.4.0, anything else (new calls, fields, enum values, deprecations, wording) to the next patch. From 1.0.0 on: breaking → major, additions → minor, wording → patch.

A method keeps its meaning once released. When the server adds a new version of a call, the SDKs get a new method with the version in its name (`create_order_v2`); the existing method keeps calling the version it was released with.

## 0.1.0 (2026-11-04)

First public contract. The SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go and Rust, these docs and the signing cases are all generated from it. Later releases list every change against this one.

First release: there is no earlier contract to compare with.
